blocks.text: Amino acid molecules can react with each other: the acidic -COOH group of one molecule reacts with the basic -NH2 group of another, and water is eliminated. When two amino acids react, the product is a dipeptide: H2N-CH(R)-COOH + H2N-CH(R)-COOH -> H2N-CH(R)-CO-NH-CH(R)-COOH + H2O. The amide bond formed between the two amino acids, -CO-NH-, is called a peptide bond or peptide link. The reaction is a condensation reaction, because a small molecule, water, is eliminated when the molecules join.

items: Tripeptide: a compound formed by the condensation of three amino acids.
Polypeptide: a compound formed by the condensation of a large number of amino acids.
Isoelectric point: the pH at which a particular amino acid has no overall charge in aqueous solution.

blocks.text: The R groups of aspartic acid and lysine are -CH2-COOH and -(CH2)4-NH2. Write (a) their formulae, (b) their zwitterions, (c) their ions in acid and (d) their ions in base, and explain what their isoelectric points mean.
